title: Towards a World Model for Biomolecular Dynamics
homepage_title: Towards a World Model for Biomolecular Dynamics

suggested_hero.en: Biomolecular ensembles, from states to fluctuations.
suggested_hero.zh: 从结构状态到原子涨落，探索生物分子构象系综。
suggested_hero.description_en: OriDynamics generates molecular-context-conditioned ensembles through latent ensemble decomposition: sampling representative states across conformational basins, then exploring all-atom variability within them.
suggested_hero.description_zh: OriDynamics 通过潜空间系综分解生成由分子环境条件化的构象系综：先跨构象盆地采样代表性状态，再探索各状态内的全原子构象变化。

homepage_abstract.en: Biomolecular recognition and regulation depend on atomic interactions that change as molecular partners fluctuate and adopt alternative conformations. Modeling these processes requires ensembles that capture both conformational diversity and coordinated atomic fluctuations between interacting molecules. Here we present OriDynamics, a unified framework for all-atom ensemble generation across protein monomers and complexes with small molecules or protein partners. OriDynamics introduces a latent ensemble decomposition that couples broad conformational exploration in a compact structural latent space with local all-atom sampling around generated proposals. Ensemble-level supervision constrains mean positions, fluctuation amplitudes and joint coordinate covariance to capture coordinated atomic variability within and between molecular partners. Across benchmarks of proteins and their complexes, OriDynamics demonstrates superior overall performance in conformational coverage, atomic fluctuation fidelity and interaction geometry compared with leading baselines. Application studies further demonstrate recovery of alternative functional conformations and partner-dependent changes in conformational ensembles alongside sampling of configurations associated with ligand dissociation. These capabilities provide a foundation for a biomolecular world model that represents accessible molecular states and their dependence on interaction context.

highlights.en: A single model generates conformational ensembles across protein monomers, protein–ligand complexes, and protein–protein assemblies.

highlights.en_title: From alternative states to local fluctuations
highlights.en: Combines latent-space exploration of alternative conformations with conditional all-atom sampling to capture local variability within each state.
Joint supervision of mean atomic positions, fluctuation amplitudes, and coordinate covariance captures how atoms fluctuate individually and together.
Achieves leading flexibility correlations across four benchmarks, alongside strong agreement with reference conformational distributions and interaction geometry.
Recovers experimentally observed alternative states and captures shifts in apo–holo conformational distributions in response to ligand or protein partners.
